## Device

Model and connection type (USB cable or receiver):

## What happened?

What did you try, what did you expect, and what actually happened?

## Report

In ReHUB, choose **Help support my device**, select the device if available, then review and download the report. Drag `rehub-device-report.txt` here, or paste its contents.

Reports and attachments are public. Do not include serial numbers, raw HID packets, macros, personal information or full browser-storage exports.

Do not flash firmware, calibrate, reset, bypass a safety gate or try unknown commands to produce a report. A successful report does not establish full device support.
